status: FROZEN BEFORE USE: written and committed before any new nominal pilot flight was flown and before any of these diagnostics was computed on existing data
question: May the nuisance condition be treated as the independent experimental unit of XSYS-001?

source_facts_used.noise_generator: glibc rand(), one process-global stream, seeded by srand(1234) in Sih::Sih() (sih.cpp:61) and again in SensorBaroSim::SensorBaroSim() (SensorBaroSim.cpp:46) at 547e2ca
source_facts_used.consumers: SIH task thread: accel + gyro Gaussian noise every 4 ms step (Marsaglia polar, rejection), ranging-beacon noise every 500 ms; hp_default work-queue thread: sensor_baro_sim (20 Hz), sensor_mag_sim (50 Hz), sensor_gps_sim (8 Hz)

definitions.span: the simulated-time interval a condition's frozen statistics read: [t0 - 5 s, t0 + 15 s)
definitions.gyro_noise_residual: r(k) = sensor_combined.gyro_rad(k) - vehicle_angular_velocity_groundtruth.xyz(k), matched at the same timestamp (3-vector)
definitions.coincident_draw: |r_a(k) - r_b(k + tau)| < 3e-4 rad/s on all three axes (tolerance > 2 x earth spin rate + float32 rounding; chance coincidence for independent draws 4.9e-6 per step pair)
definitions.frozen_statistics: L_T1, D_T1, L_T3, C_T3 computed ONLY with research/xsys_confirmatory_001/pipeline/xsys_features.py, for every motor m = 0..3, at pseudo-onsets
definitions.memory_signals: the per-step signals the frozen statistics are functions of: rho_m (RPM ratio, every motor), gyro roll and pitch rate, kappa_m (allocator command ratio, every motor)

diagnostics.DX1_noise_draw_identity: I(a,b) = max over ALL lags tau of (number of coincident draws at lag tau) / (steps in span a). Computed by exact global matching, not a limited lag window.
diagnostics.DX5_family_membership: zero-lag coincident-draw fraction per 1 s simulated-time bin for every pair of flights; same family in a bin if >= 0.99, different if <= 0.01; the branch time of a pair is the first bin after which it stays <= 0.01
diagnostics.DX2_DX3_statistic_lag_correlation: rho_{s,s',m}(Delta) = Pearson correlation between statistic s at pseudo-onset t and statistic s' at pseudo-onset t + Delta in ONE flight (one stochastic stream), pseudo-onsets every 0.2 s, for s, s' in {L_T1, D_T1, L_T3, C_T3} and every motor m; D is W_DYN, C is W_CTRL
diagnostics.DX6_memory: tau_mem = max over memory_signals of the smallest lag L such that |autocorrelation(lag)| <= 0.1 for every lag in [L, L + 60 s], from a long nominal hover (after removing each signal's mean over the hover)
diagnostics.DX4_trajectory_dependence: Pearson correlation between two conditions' span signals aligned on relative time t - t0 (gyro projected on motor 0's loss axis, kappa_0, rho_0, true roll and pitch rate)

rules.required_onset_separation: S_min = 20 s (span length) + tau_mem; the design uses S = S_min rounded UP to the next multiple of 5 s
rules.evaluation_of_original_design: descriptive: family rates among identically configured launches (DX5), zero-lag identity inside original-design spans, and rho(Delta) at the original onset separations 0.5 to 5 s

acceptance_criteria.C1_no_shared_draws: DX1 I(a,b) <= 0.001 for every pair of distinct pilot design conditions (spans extended backwards by tau_mem)
acceptance_criteria.C3_statistics_uncorrelated_at_S: |mean of rho_{s,s',m}(Delta) over Delta in [S, S + 10 s]| <= 0.1 for every s, s', m, in the long nominal hover
acceptance_criteria.C4_trajectories_uncorrelated: |DX4 correlation| <= 0.1 for every signal and every pair of distinct pilot design conditions
acceptance_criteria.C5_threshold_validity: in every pilot design condition span and in the long hover, every frozen null statistic at hover pseudo-onsets stays below its frozen threshold (|L_T1| < delta_rpm, |D_T1| < theta_dyn, |C_T3| < theta_ctrl), and the true heading over T0 is within 5 deg of the commanded heading
acceptance_criteria.decision: the nuisance condition is accepted as the independent unit iff C1..C5 all hold; otherwise XSYS_001_REQUIRES_FURTHER_DESIGN_WORK
